title: Two Sum
problem: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.
intuition: For every number x, we need to determine whether target - x has already appeared. A hash map allows us to remember previously visited values and their indices.
approach: Traverse the array once. For each number calculate its complement. If the complement exists in the hash map, return its stored index and the current index. Otherwise store the current number and its index.
algorithm: If it exists, return both indices.
Otherwise store the current number and index.
mistakes: Returning the values instead of their indices.
Checking the current element after inserting it into the map.
Using nested loops when a hash map solution is expected.
solution: Use a hash map to store previously visited values and their indices.
